subject: planner: fix hash partition prune with `is null` condition (#58383)
summary: Reviewed diff vs first parent for planner hash partition pruning. Change deduplicates extracted hash-partition columns by UniqueID (avoids repeated-column Index overwrite) and treats point ranges missing some partition-expression columns as FullRange, preventing incorrect pruning/crashes on `IS NULL` predicates. Checked later history: logic persists on upstream/master (file moved to `pkg/planner/core/rule/rule_partition_processor.go`) with no follow-up fixes specific to this area.
